model_organism.citation: Genetic association for renal traits among participants of African ancestry reveals new loci for renal function (PMID: 21931561)

biological.citation: ASHG 2011 - Two novel loci for melanoma susceptibility on chromosome bands 1q42.12 and 1q21.3 (MacGregor et al.)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is located in the linkage disequilibrium region of the melanoma susceptibility locus at 1q21.3 (rs7412746). The SNP rs7412746 acts as an eQTL that explains a substantial proportion of variance in expression of ARNT and CTSS, with expression of ARNT correlated with other genes in the region including CTSK and SETDB1.
biological.sample_size: Discovery: 2,168 cases/4,387 controls; Replication: 2,804 cases/7,618 controls (Europe), 1,804 cases/1,026 controls (USA 1), 585 cases/6,500 controls (USA 2); Melanoma cell lines: N=39 (Affymetrix) and N=38 (Illumina)
